title: Bayesian Neural Networks via Dirichlet Process Priors on the Data-Generating Distribution for Randomized Value Functions in Deep Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27570v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) offer a principled framework for quantifying epistemic uncertainty. However, standard weight-space priors yield complex, high-dimensional neural network posteriors that are computationally prohibitive to sample from, and popular approximate inference schemes often fail to capture epistemic uncertainty effectively---a failure mode particularly acute in reinforcement learning (RL) \citep{osband2018randomized}. To resolve this challenge, we introduce a new class of BNNs that quantify uncertainty by placing Bayesian nonparametric Dirichlet Process (DP) priors directly on the underlying data-generating distribution rather than on network parameters. Building on this foundation, we develop DP-DQN, a reinforcement learning algorithm that leverages DP-BNNs to maintain posterior distributions over value functions and perform efficient Thompson sampling. translated_title: 基于数据生成分布上狄利克雷过程先验的贝叶斯神经网络在深度强化学习随机化价值函数中的应用
translated_abstract: 贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）为量化认知不确定性提供了一个有原则的框架。然而，标准的权重空间先验会产生复杂的高维神经网络后验，从中采样在计算上代价极高，且流行的近似推断方案往往无法有效捕捉认知不确定性——这种失效模式在强化学习（RL）中尤为突出。为解决这一挑战，我们引入了一类新的BNN，它通过在底层数据生成分布上（而非网络参数上）直接施加贝叶斯非参数狄利克雷过程（DP）先验来量化不确定性。在此基础上，我们开发了DP-DQN，这是一种强化学习算法，它利用DP-BNN来维护价值函数上的后验分布，并执行高效的汤普森采样。通过将随机化价值函数建立在贝叶斯非参……
tldr: 该论文提出在数据生成分布上（而非网络权重上）施加狄利克雷过程先验来构建新型贝叶斯神经网络DP-BNN，并据此开发了DP-DQN算法，通过随机化价值函数实现高效的汤普森采样，从而解决深度强化学习中认知不确定性量化的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new class of Bayesian neural networks that quantify uncertainty by placing Dirichlet Process priors on the data-generating distribution instead of network parameters, and introduces DP-DQN, a deep RL algorithm that uses these DP-BNNs to maintain posterior distributions over value functions for efficient Thompson sampling.
